CROSS CHECK YOUR HALL TICKET TO CONFIRM THE SUBJECTS TO BE WRITTEN. (IF IT IS NOT THE CORRECT SUBJECT, PLS CHECK THE SECTION AT THE TOP FOR THE SUBJECTS REGISTERED BY YOU)

For the following situation, what sampling method is optimal? A company plans to do a house-to-house field survey to find usage level of branded basmati rice. The required sample size is 600, spread across upper middle class households

For the following situation, what sampling method is optimal? An insurance firm wants to conduct a small sample study to understand the attitude of families towards health insurance as a product. The required sample size is 20, and the nature of probing will be in-depth.

For the following situation, what sampling method is optimal? A hospital chain wants to find out how satisfied the discharged patients are and if they will recommend the hospital to others. The hospital wants a sample size of 300 discharged patients selected in such a way as to ensure proportionate representation to those who underwent surgery, were in the ICU, etc.

For the following situation, what sampling method is optimal? A retailer wants to do a study over phone among those who have bought bread but not bought cheese from the store. They have a list of all such customers with their name and phone number. The required sample size is 300 customers

For the following situation, what sampling method is optimal? A skin care company plans to test out a new serum concept meant for controlling acne among young men. The targeted sample size is 30 and the probing will be qualitative in nature

A manufacturer of mobile phones wants to do a sample survey about the brand standing of its brand. It plans to do a house-to-house multistage cluster sampling survey. The company classifies its customers based on gender (men / women) and age (Young / Early middle age / Late middle age / Elder) and customizes its designs accordingly. The company wants to do the study in two cities. The company wants to have a robust sample size in EACH city with no compromises. What should be the sample size totally, for the two cities put together? NOTE: Please round off the answer to NO DECIMALS and choose the appropriate option here

An insurance firm decides to do a customer satisfaction study and decides that the key metric will be the mean score of satisfaction measured on a 5 point scale (from very poor to very good). The company wants to be 95% confident that the findings on the mean score on the 5 point scale is plus or minus 10% accurate. What should be the sample size? NOTE: Please round off the answer to NO DECIMALS and choose the appropriate option here

The same insurance firm decides to do a customer satisfaction study and decides that the key metric will be the percentage of customers who give 4 or 5 on the 5-point scale, and wants the same level of accuracy (plus or minus 10% accurate) and confidence (95%), then what should be the sample size?. NOTE: Please round off the answer to NO DECIMALS and choose the appropriate option here
